name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private /evi-first Evidence Lane workflow with atomic Boot/Flash, conditional fresh-window State Travel, universal Plan/Delta events, automatic exit sealing, exact-APPROVE Fuse, prompt-indexed rollback, and capability-based durable persistence.

interface.shortDescription: Run atomic /evi Boot/Flash and governed PV State Travel.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane starts a normal /evi flow with atomic Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash through /evi-01-boot, while a prepared post-Fuse handoff enters through /evi-00-state-travel in a fresh host window. It keeps /evi-mode available for intersecting ENV15 modes, Chat Lineage, and an append-only Planning-mode projection; accepts one explicit Git or local-code source; governs one project, agent, and active task across eighteen deterministic SQLite/MMD/DOT sectors; preserves one universal Delta lifecycle; automatically seals task exit candidates; Fuses only exact APPROVE; supports six-way HIL plus prompt-indexed pointer-only rollback; and keeps the governed session active until /evi-exit-boot.
defaultPrompt: Run /evi: atomically Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash, then show the ordered source-intake choices.
Use /evi-02-git with one exact repository and branch, or /evi-03-local with one exact local Git path.
Complete one bounded Delta, auto-Refresh the exit candidate, show six-way HIL, and wait for my exact decision.
